feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Federal government failed to hold Epstein accountable, Republican committee says
entry.summary: The Republican chair of the House Oversight Committee released a scathing report after a 15-month investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. It faulted the federal government with decades of failing to hold Epstein accountable.

entry.title: House votes to effectively end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
entry.summary: House Republicans managed to short-circuit a floor vote on the impeachment effort brought against the Defense Secretary by Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie.

entry.title: Supreme Court seems split over federal agencies' ability to fine for law violations
entry.summary: The Supreme Court heard arguments Tuesday in a case related to temporary worker visas. The company involved says enforcement issues should go through the courts, not the federal agency alone.

entry.title: Russia's most famous independent newspaper has shut down after more than 30 years
entry.summary: Russia's top independent newspaper is closing after more than 30 years amid state pressure and censorship laws. Its founder won the Nobel Peace Prize and several of its journalists have been killed.

entry.title: Tattoo artists are carrying Rembrandt's art into a new era — and a new medium
entry.summary: The Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam hosted an unusual exhibit in recent weeks — a renowned tattoo artist inking the Dutch master's designs on visitors' skin.

entry.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
entry.summary: Drone makers are testing new, big drones that can deliver water or fire retardant with AI assistance. Aspen, Colorado is the first place trying them out. Cool and expensive? Yes. Effective? TBD.

entry.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
entry.summary: The U.S. has skipped a key U.N. human rights review for the second year running. Rights groups warn the absence risks undermining global accountability.

entry.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
entry.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

entry.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
entry.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

entry.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
entry.summary: Little is known about her except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae, but Korea's spy agency says she's likely her father's heir.
